body: 8 pet kinds (wolf/bird/lizard/crab/leech/slime/worm/bear). Slot tracks one BST player's companion. Tame() checks HP ≤70% + chance roll. JugPet() no-roll summon with 5s cooldown. Tick() autonomous auto-attack on swing timer. TakeDamage()/Heal()/Release(). 20 tests all pass.
title: S104-01: BST pet system — server/pet/pet.go + 20 tests
